entry_points.text: Guest-host speculation switch plus reschedule and single/mask call-function IPIs provide virtualization and CPU request handoffs.
Context switch delegates to asm and reports prior task; kthread init places entry and arg in width-dependent preserved slots.

exports.text: Single-step guard preserves debugger stop over resume with FRED; SIMD allowed exactly when FPU usable in IRQ context; user shadow store reports fault via exception table; nop serialize tile-release give single-insn effects with barrier where needed.

Boot canary picks random value into task and guard cell, per-CPU copies idle or no-ops; guard true only when address outside all stacks yet one page higher inside, containment needs known kind and full enclosure; inline copy/fill move arbitrary bytes returning dest.

Sysenter refresh skips redundant TR/sysenter update by comparing per-CPU and thread state, stack update keeps trampoline on 32-bit and reloads top for PV without fast return on 64-bit; 64-bit wrapper expands saved regs to six args in native order.

hazards.text: Unchecked CLAC/STAC carry ignore annotation and must wrap only validated regions; MWAIT idle helper in this config always faults.

Enqueue submits one 64-byte command and reports busy-retry via zero flag; core sync prefers serialize else 32/64-bit IRET-to-self, fallback unmasks NMIs and is slow, other paths may fault or trap, pre-usermode bypasses when isolation serializes.

invariants.text: When 32-bit compat names are needed, ia32 frame, realtime frame and context alias the generic types.
Physical id comes from per-CPU APIC map and logical id from per-CPU number; last-level sharing has per-CPU and CPU-zero-only configs with L2 map alongside.
32-bit compare delegates to compiler builtin; cache cleaning walks every line overlapping the range from aligned base by line size.
Build-time layout pins: classic save 744, comm save 1032, encrypted save 1648, control 1024 with save offset equal control size, comm block one page, reserved gaps at fixed hex offsets.

locks.text: Cross-CPU bit updates use hardware locked read-modify-write, not software locks; callers own address lifetime and multi-bit invariants.

state_machines.text: Retry discipline: success means done, retry plus resumable or busy means reissue, operand errors need caller fix, non-recoverable is terminal.
Helpers derive bitmap index as offset over eight with validity test, raw and guarded fetch, and storing setter; field starts invalid, valid after setter, guarded reads zero until then.

structs.text: Leaves 0x10000-0x10004 for info, map, quote, fatal, notify; status 0 success, 1 retry, 0x8000000000000000 invalid, 0x8000000000000002 align, 0x8000000000000003 unsupported; sizes 4K 0 2M 1 1G 2 count 3; operands RCX 01 TDR 80 SEPT 92 epoch A9.
SHM attach aligns to base page; sparsemem 29/36, 26/32, 27/(52 if L5 else 46) section/phys bits; restorable flags combine AC OF DF TF SF ZF AF PF CF RF; spin threshold 32768.

32-bit classic keeps pretcode sig sc placeholder extramask retcode then FP, RT adds pinfo puc info uc; 64-bit RT orders pretcode uc info then FP; x32 packs flags link compat stack pad mcontext mask-last with pretcode context info FP.

Thread shadow holds base then size; module carrier holds 13 u64 RCX RDX R8-R15 RBX RDI RSI; SMP ops centralize boot prep, stop/crash, reschedule, cleanup, kick, disable/die, idle and call-function IPIs.
Stack kinds unknown task IRQ softIRQ entry plus exception range; descriptor carries kind begin end next-sp; native and 32-bit frames pair older-link with return address.

32-bit suspend packs CRs misc-enable MSRs GDT IDT LDT TR safety return GS; 64-bit adds trap regs segs bases CRs misc MSRs XCR padded descriptors LDT TR safety return; debug restore writes one saved breakpoint reg.

Control holds intercepts pause perms time ASID TLB virt-int exit nested APIC SEV tail; intercepts group CR DR exc insn sys virt TLB bus-lock; seg 12B selector attrib limit base; classic segs CPL EFER CR DR IP stacks CET syscall fault branch exc spec; encrypted adds shadows CET XSS debug GPRs exit virt TSC PKRU FP; GHCB sparse save plus validity half-block plus ~2KB buffer version tail one page; VMCB control plus classic/encrypted host union.
TLB modes none, full, tagged, local-tagged in low three bits; low misc bits enable nested paging, SEV, SEV-ES; ERAP low bits select allow-larger and clear.

Logical AVIC guest low 8b valid bit31; physical host low12 backing 12-51 log-int running valid top table 8b doorbell/index 12b; unaccel low write bit offset low12 minus low4 vector 32b failures bad-type not-running bad-target bad-page bad-vector; ceilings 254 511 4095; SEV active 0 restricted 3 alternate 4 debug-swap 5 secure-TSC 9 allowed-valid top bit.
Switch frame preserves callee-saved regs with frame pointer and return adjacent for unwind; fork frame nests header above full snapshot.
